title: 分馏、减压蒸馏与回流
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/170_分馏、减压蒸馏与回流.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/170_分馏、减压蒸馏与回流/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜里，旁边是旋转蒸发仪和回流装置
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a fume hood beside a rotary evaporator and a reflux setup with an upright condenser, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第八课：分馏、减压蒸馏与回流。

shots.scene: 阿杰把有星裂的锥形瓶接上真空
shots.prompt_en: The young male student connects a thin cone-shaped flask with a visible star crack to a vacuum hose, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿有裂纹的锥形瓶抽真空。

shots.scene: 回流装置冷凝管顶上塞着塞子，旁边没人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heated reflux setup with a stopper jammed into the top of the condenser and an empty chair beside it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 回流顶上还塞着塞子，人走了。

shots.scene: 小研拔掉电源，叫停
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the heating and stops the young male student, shaking her head.
shots.narration: 小研：停！三种装置各有规矩。

shots.scene: 两条沸点很近的刻度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two liquids with boiling point icons very close together on a scale, a simple distillation setup with a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 沸点很接近，简单蒸馏分不开。

shots.scene: 烧瓶和蒸馏头之间加分馏柱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vertical fractionating column with packing inserted between the round-bottom flask and the distillation head. No text.
shots.narration: 在烧瓶和蒸馏头之间加分馏柱。

shots.scene: 柱内一次次汽化冷凝，越往上越纯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: inside the column, vapor condensing and re-vaporizing level by level, the low-boiling component getting richer toward the top. No text.
shots.narration: 一次次汽化冷凝，越往上越纯。

shots.scene: 分馏非常慢地加热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power controller turned up very gradually, a gentle boil and a slowly rising vapor front in the column. No text.
shots.narration: 加热要慢，馏出慢而稳，柱里才平衡。

shots.scene: 太猛混在一起，太弱上不到顶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a violent boil flooding the column crossed out, a weak boil where vapor stalls halfway crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 太猛就分不开，太弱蒸气上不去。

shots.scene: 【实拍】柱外包保温层和铝箔
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands wrap insulating material and then aluminum foil around a cold fractionating column.
shots.narration: 散热太快，柱外包保温层和铝箔。

shots.scene: 沸点高的液体常压加热分解
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a high-boiling liquid in a flask heated strongly, molecules breaking apart and darkening, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 沸点高的，常压加热容易分解。

shots.scene: 外压降低，沸点降低
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure gauge needle dropping and the boiling point arrow moving down at the same time. No text.
shots.narration: 外压降低，较低温度就能沸腾。

shots.scene: 用列线图估算减压沸点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a nomograph chart with three scales and a ruler line connecting two points to read the third. No text.
shots.narration: 减压沸点，可用列线图估算。

shots.scene: 只用圆底厚壁烧瓶并查裂纹，平底锥形瓶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a round-bottom flask and a thick-walled filter flask checked, a flat-bottom flask and a thin cone-shaped flask crossed out under vacuum arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 只用圆底厚壁玻璃，先查裂纹。

shots.scene: 装置前加防护屏，戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a transparent safety shield in front of the vacuum setup inside the hood, a student in safety goggles behind it. No text.
shots.narration: 装置前加防护屏，戴好护目镜。

shots.scene: 烧瓶上加克氏蒸馏头挡冲料
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a two-neck bent head mounted on the flask, a bump splash caught in the extra arm instead of reaching the condenser. No text.
shots.narration: 加克氏蒸馏头，挡住暴沸冲料。

shots.scene: 多尾接液管挂几个接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multi-arm receiving adapter with three small flasks hanging from it at the end of the condenser. No text.
shots.narration: 末端接多尾接液管，挂几个瓶。

shots.scene: 真空下转一转就换瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the multi-arm adapter rotated a little so drops fall into the next flask, a hand removing a flask under vacuum crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 真空下不拆瓶，转一转就换瓶。

shots.scene: 【实拍】抽气口接厚壁真空管
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a thick-walled rubber vacuum tube pushed firmly onto the vacuum inlet of the adapter, a thin collapsed tube beside it with a cross.
shots.narration: 抽气口接厚壁真空管，薄管会瘪。

shots.scene: 真空源、安全瓶、压力计
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vacuum pump connected through a trap bottle and a pressure gauge to the setup, arrows of airflow. No text.
shots.narration: 接真空泵，中间加安全瓶和压力计。

shots.scene: 冷阱挡住溶剂蒸气，泵尾气进通风柜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cold trap catching solvent vapor before the pump, the pump exhaust tube led into a fume hood. No text.
shots.narration: 冷阱挡住溶剂，泵尾气进通风柜。

shots.scene: 加液氮戴面屏和低温手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in a face shield and cryogenic gloves slowly pouring liquid nitrogen into the trap flask, fog rising. No text.
shots.narration: 冷阱加液氮，戴面屏和低温手套。

shots.scene: 【实拍】阳口上部薄涂一层脂，转一圈透明
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a fingertip spreads a thin even band of grease on the upper part of a male ground glass joint, then the joint is twisted until clear all around.
shots.narration: 磨口薄涂脂，转到整圈透明。

shots.scene: 关活塞开真空，逐个开听嘶声
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: all stopcocks closed, the pump on, then stopcocks opened one by one from the pump side, a hissing sound icon at a leaking joint. No text.
shots.narration: 关活塞开真空，逐个打开听嘶声。

shots.scene: 漏了：关真空、放气、重新涂脂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cycle of vacuum off, vent, re-grease the joint and test again, then a check mark when no leak. No text.
shots.narration: 漏就关真空放气，重涂再试。

shots.scene: 不漏后再加液氮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a no leak check mark followed by liquid nitrogen being added to the trap, a leaking system with a pale blue droplet warning crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 确认不漏，再给冷阱加液氮。

shots.scene: 【实拍】液体倒入烧瓶，放入搅拌子
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a liquid poured through a funnel into a round-bottom flask, then a stir bar slid in at room temperature.
shots.narration: 液体转入烧瓶，放入搅拌子。

shots.scene: 沸石孔里的气被抽光，失效
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a boiling chip with its pores emptied by vacuum arrows, a broken bubble icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 真空下沸石的气被抽光，没用。

shots.scene: 或用毛细管通入细小气泡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fine capillary tube dipping into the flask, a thin stream of tiny bubbles rising. No text.
shots.narration: 也可插毛细管，冒细泡防暴沸。

shots.scene: 加热套就位，先开搅拌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the heating mantle raised under the flask but switched off, the stirrer turned on first. No text.
shots.narration: 加热套就位先不热，先开搅拌。

shots.scene: 慢慢抽真空，冒泡是空气和低沸物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the vacuum valve opened slowly, bubbles rising in the unheated flask, a pressure gauge needle dropping. No text.
shots.narration: 慢慢抽真空，没加热也会冒泡。

shots.scene: 冒泡停了再加热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the bubbles stopped and steady pressure, then the heating controller turned on gently. No text.
shots.narration: 压力稳了、冒泡停了，再加热。

shots.scene: 结束：先撤热源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the heating mantle lowered away from the flask, the stirrer still running, the vacuum still on. No text.
shots.narration: 结束：先撤热源，继续搅拌。

shots.scene: 完全冷却后慢慢放气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock icon until the flask is cool, then a vent valve opened slowly with a gentle air arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 冷透后再一点点放气，猛放会冲料。

shots.scene: 放气后停泵、停搅拌、取瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an order of icons, vent, pump off, stirrer off, receivers removed, numbered by dots. No text.
shots.narration: 放完气，再停泵停搅拌、取瓶。

shots.scene: 样品溶在溶剂里，要除去溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask of solution after an extraction or a column, an arrow to solid product left behind. No text.
shots.narration: 萃取过柱后，要把溶剂除掉。

shots.scene: 旋转蒸发仪各部分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotary evaporator with a vacuum line, a warm water bath, a bump trap, a motor, a condenser and a receiving flask, arrows to each. No text.
shots.narration: 真空、水浴、防溅球、电机、冷凝管。

shots.scene: 减压降沸点，水浴补热，旋转成膜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotating flask with a thin liquid film on its wall, a low pressure icon and a warm bath arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 减压旋转蒸得快，溶剂进接收瓶。

shots.scene: 扎起头发，不穿宽袖，摘首饰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student with tied-back hair, fitted sleeves and no jewelry at a rotary evaporator, a loose sleeve near the motor crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 扎头发，不穿宽袖，摘下首饰。

shots.scene: 烧瓶最多装一半
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pear or round flask filled to half with a check mark, a full flask crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 烧瓶最多装一半。

shots.scene: 太满暴沸冲进防溅球，更费时
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an overfilled rotating flask bumping, liquid shooting into the bump trap, a longer clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 装太满会暴沸，反而更费时间。

shots.scene: 瓶里不能有固体和搅拌子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask with solid particles and a stir bar crossed out, a clear solution checked. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶里不能有固体，搅拌子也取出。

shots.scene: 【实拍】防溅球洗净，再用溶剂冲一遍
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a clean bump trap rinsed with a small amount of solvent from a wash bottle over a beaker inside a hood.
shots.narration: 防溅球洗净，用前再冲一遍。

shots.scene: 先通冷却水，水管绑牢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cooling water flowing through the evaporator coil, hose connections tied firmly, a loose hose crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 先通冷却水，水管接口绑牢。

shots.scene: 【实拍】接收瓶放进冰浴
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the receiving flask of the rotary evaporator set into a small bowl of ice water.
shots.narration: 接收瓶放冰浴，少让蒸气跑掉。

shots.scene: 先查烧瓶裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier checking the evaporating flask for cracks before use. No text.
shots.narration: 烧瓶先查裂纹，有伤不用。

shots.scene: 【实拍】烧瓶接上防溅球，用夹子夹牢
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a round flask pushed onto the bump trap joint and locked with a joint clip, the hand checking it holds.
shots.narration: 烧瓶接防溅球，用夹子夹牢。

shots.scene: 先抽一点真空再旋转
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the vacuum gauge needle dropping a little first, then the rotation icon starting. No text.
shots.narration: 先抽一点真空吸住，再开旋转。

shots.scene: 没吸住就转，烧瓶掉进水浴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask spinning without vacuum slipping off and falling into the water bath, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 没吸住就转，烧瓶会掉下去。

shots.scene: 慢开真空，盯住鼓泡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the vacuum valve opened slowly while watching the bubbling in the flask, the valve eased back when bubbling is violent. No text.
shots.narration: 慢慢开真空，鼓泡太猛就调小。

shots.scene: 蒸发稳定再放入水浴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: steady gentle evaporation, then the rotating flask lowered into the warm bath, frost on the flask crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 蒸发稳了，再把烧瓶放进水浴。

shots.scene: 水浴温度适中
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bath temperature dial set to a moderate value suited to the solvent, an overheated steaming bath crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 水浴温度按溶剂选，别过高。

shots.scene: 蒸到黏稠贴壁，必要时上高真空
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the residue turning into a sticky film on the flask wall, then the flask moved to a high vacuum line. No text.
shots.narration: 蒸到黏稠贴壁，残留再上高真空。

shots.scene: 取瓶：抬出水浴，停转
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the flask lifted out of the bath and the rotation switched off. No text.
shots.narration: 取瓶：抬出水浴，先停旋转。

shots.scene: 【实拍】托住烧瓶，慢慢放气，再取夹子
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: one hand supports the round flask from below while the vent valve is opened slowly, then the joint clip is removed.
shots.narration: 托住烧瓶慢放气，再取夹子。

shots.scene: 出意外先停机，别伸手捞
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask fallen into the bath, a hand reaching into the bath crossed out, motor off and heat off icons first, then vent. No text.
shots.narration: 掉瓶冲料：先停机停热，别伸手捞。

shots.scene: 处理不了报告负责人
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports a fallen flask to the older man beside the rotary evaporator.
shots.narration: 处理不了，马上报告负责人。

shots.scene: 密闭加热会炸，敞口溶剂跑掉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed heated flask bursting crossed out, an open beaker losing solvent vapor crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 密闭加热会炸，敞口溶剂会跑。

shots.scene: 冷凝管把蒸气变回液体流回
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask boiling under an upright condenser, vapor condensing into drops that run back into the flask in a loop. No text.
shots.narration: 竖着的冷凝管，把蒸气冷回瓶里。

shots.scene: 长时间在沸点加热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long clock icon beside a steadily refluxing setup, a reaction arrow moving forward. No text.
shots.narration: 能在沸点长时间加热，反应更快。

shots.scene: 溶剂：溶解试剂、不反应、沸点合适
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solvent bottle with three check icons, dissolving all reagents, not reacting with them, a suitable boiling point. No text.
shots.narration: 溶剂要溶得了、不反应、沸点合适。

shots.scene: 装量不超过一半
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a round-bottom flask filled to half with the dissolved reagents, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 试剂溶好倒进烧瓶，不超过一半。

shots.scene: 过热突然喷大气泡：暴沸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a superheated solution suddenly erupting with a huge bubble, liquid spraying and a small flame icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 过热会突然暴沸，损料甚至着火。

shots.scene: 搅拌打散气泡，沸石冒细泡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spinning stir bar breaking up large bubbles, a porous boiling chip releasing tiny bubbles. No text.
shots.narration: 搅拌打散气泡，沸石冒出细泡。

shots.scene: 沸石加热前放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: boiling chips added to the cold flask with a check mark, chips dropped into a hot solution erupting crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 沸石一定在加热前放进去。

shots.scene: 【实拍】烧瓶夹牢，冷凝管竖直接上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a round-bottom flask clamped at the neck on a stand, an upright condenser fitted vertically into it and clamped as well.
shots.narration: 烧瓶夹牢，冷凝管竖直接上夹好。

shots.scene: 【实拍】下口进水上口出，管箍箍紧
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hoses attached to the lower inlet and the upper outlet of the upright condenser, hose clamps tightened on both.
shots.narration: 下进上出，两根水管都箍紧。

shots.scene: 【实拍】冷凝管顶端敞开
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger points to the open top of the upright condenser, no stopper in it.
shots.narration: 开始前确认：冷凝管顶端敞开。

shots.scene: 顶端塞死加热，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stopper in the top of a refluxing condenser, pressure building and the glass bursting, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不加热密闭体系。

shots.scene: 加热套宁大勿小，放在升降台上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heating mantle matching the flask on a lab jack with room below to lower it, an open flame crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 加热套宁大勿小，下方能撤。

shots.scene: 加热套接调压器，不直插墙插座
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heating mantle cord plugged into a power controller, a cord plugged straight into a wall socket crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 加热套接调压器，不直插墙插座。

shots.scene: 通水后慢慢升温到平稳沸腾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the cooling water checked flowing, then the controller turned up slowly until a steady boil. No text.
shots.narration: 先开水，再慢慢升温到平稳沸腾。

shots.scene: 冷凝环停在冷凝管一半以下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ring of condensing droplets inside the upright condenser held at about the lower half, a mark at the middle. No text.
shots.narration: 调加热，让冷凝环停在一半以下。

shots.scene: 太高样品跑掉，太低反应拖慢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ring near the top with vapor escaping crossed out, a ring barely above the flask with a slow clock crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 太高会跑料，太低反应拖很久。

shots.scene: 回流时有人看守
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student watching a refluxing setup in a fume hood, an empty lab at night with a reflux running crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 回流加热不离人，过夜按规定。

shots.scene: 常看水流和沸腾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flow indicator on the water line spinning, an eye icon checking the boil and the condensing ring. No text.
shots.narration: 常看水流、沸腾和冷凝环高度。

shots.scene: 结束：撤热，冷了再关水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the mantle lowered away, a clock until the flask is cool, then the water tap closed. No text.
shots.narration: 结束：撤热源，瓶凉了再关水。

shots.scene: 水管老化定期换
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an old cracked rubber hose replaced with a new one, a calendar icon. No text.
shots.narration: 橡胶水管会老化，定期检查更换。

shots.scene: 断水马上撤热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the water flow stopping, vapor rising out of the condenser top, the heat immediately removed. No text.
shots.narration: 一旦断水，马上撤热，再查原因。

shots.scene: 顶上装干燥管挡水汽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a drying tube filled loosely with drying agent on top of the condenser, moisture icons blocked, the system still open. No text.
shots.narration: 要无水，顶上装干燥管挡水汽。

shots.scene: 【实拍】干燥剂装松一点，吹一吹通气
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a drying tube loosely filled with granules and plugged with a little cotton, air gently blown through to show it is not blocked.
shots.narration: 干燥剂装松，用前查是否通气。

shots.scene: 结块堵死就成了密闭加热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a drying tube with caked solid blocking the outlet, pressure building in the flask, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 结块堵死，就成了密闭加热。

shots.scene: 三通接氮气和鼓泡器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three-way adapter on the condenser top, one arm to a nitrogen line and one arm to a liquid bubbler venting into the hood. No text.
shots.narration: 或接三通，一头氮气一头鼓泡器。

shots.scene: 滴液漏斗装在侧口，冷凝管在正上方
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a two-neck setup with the condenser on the center neck and an addition funnel on the side neck, all joints greased. No text.
shots.narration: 冷凝管装正上方，滴液漏斗装侧口。

shots.scene: 三颈瓶空口塞隔垫
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three-neck flask with a rubber septum on the unused neck. No text.
shots.narration: 也可用三颈瓶，空口塞上隔垫。

shots.scene: 放热反应一滴一滴慢慢加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: reagent dripping slowly from the addition funnel, the condensing ring watched, the addition stopped when the ring rises fast. No text.
shots.narration: 放热反应慢慢滴，环升太快就停。

shots.scene: 没恒压管滴不动，开上口塞
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an addition funnel without a side tube not dripping, its top stopper briefly removed so liquid flows again. No text.
shots.narration: 没恒压管滴不动，取下上口塞。

shots.scene: 接收瓶里的溶剂进废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the receiving flask of the rotary evaporator emptied into a labeled organic waste container, a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 旋蒸收回的溶剂，按废液收集。

shots.scene: 含卤不含卤分开
